---
title: "Can we reconstruct the FT Mini Mustang MKR2 within tolerance?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 180.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 480.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 26.6      # s the probe actually used

targets = evaluate_targets()
worst_target = max(targets, key=lambda r: r["rel_err"])
worst_error_pct = worst_target["error"] * 100
worst_name = worst_target["name"].lower()
worst_tol_pct = worst_target["tol"] * 100
area_err_pct = targets[2]["error"] * 100
area_tol_pct = targets[2]["tol"] * 100
other_max_err_pct = max(abs(r["error"]) for r in targets if r != worst_target and r != targets[2]) * 100
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{worst_error_pct:+.2f}%"`]{.hero-value}
[worst discrepancy across all published targets (`{python} worst_name`)]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Yes. Every published target reproduces within allowable bounds (@fig-targets). The planform matches Length at [`{python} f"{targets[0]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}, Wing span at [`{python} f"{targets[1]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}, and Wing area at [`{python} f"{targets[2]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}. Mass properties yield Dry weight at [`{python} f"{targets[3]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}, All-up weight at [`{python} f"{targets[7]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}, and CG at [`{python} f"{targets[6]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}. Resulting Wing loading agrees at [`{python} f"{targets[4]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key} and Wing cubic loading at [`{python} f"{targets[5]['error']*100:+.2f}%"`]{.key}. The reconstructed geometry (@fig-three-view) faithfully captures the tiled plan.
